modelo210.metaTitle: Modelo 210 for property owners who live outside Spain
modelo210.metaDescription: Who has to file Spain's Modelo 210, how the tax is calculated and when it is due. A guided calculator is in preparation.
modelo210.title: Modelo 210: Spain's tax for owners who live elsewhere
modelo210.lead: If you own a home in Spain but are not tax resident there, Spain expects a Modelo 210 every year. That applies even if the home is never rented and earns nothing.

facts.label: Who files
facts.value: Anyone who owns property in Spain and is not tax resident there. Each co-owner files separately.

facts.label: Used by you or standing empty
facts.value: Spain taxes a notional income: 1.1% of the cadastral value if that value was revised in the last 10 years, otherwise 2%.

facts.label: Rented out
facts.value: The rent you received. Residents of the EU and EEA may deduct costs, others may not.

facts.label: Tax rate
facts.value: 19% for residents of the EU and EEA, 24% for everyone else, including Switzerland and the United Kingdom.

facts.label: Deadlines
facts.value: Own use: by 31 December of the following year. Rent: between 1 and 20 January of the following year.
